title: pvResampleAMR
body:
## pvResampleAMR

Samples overlapping AMR data (vtkOverlappingAMR) onto a uniform grid covering the box from Min to Max with NumberofSamples points per axis, taking each value from the finest level that covers the sample. The result is a multiblock of uniform-grid partitions (NumberOfPartitions) with the fields on points (TransferToNodes true) or cells. Use it to compare AMR results with regular-grid data or to export a fixed-resolution image; use pvConvertAMRdatasettoMultiblock to keep the native blocks.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Min and Max both start at [0, 0, 0], which describes no region; always set the box.
- Parts of the box outside the AMR domain are trimmed, so the grid may have fewer points than requested.
- Input data are assumed cell-centred and rectilinear AMR is not supported.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ResampleAMR`. Identity: `filters/AMRResampleFilter`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input for this filter. Accepted data: overlapping AMR data (vtkOverlappingAMR). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkOverlappingAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DemandDrivenMode` | This property specifies whether the resampling filter will operate in demand-driven mode or not. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Max` | Upper corner [x, y, z] of the box to resample, in the dataset's coordinate units. Together with Min it defines the region; parts beyond the AMR domain are trimmed. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Min` | Lower corner [x, y, z] of the box to resample, in the dataset's coordinate units. Together with Max it defines the region; parts outside the AMR domain are trimmed to the domain bounds. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `NumberOfPartitions` | Set the number of subdivisions for recursive coordinate bisection. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `NumberofSamples` | Sets the number of samples in each dimension | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `TransferToNodes` | This property specifies whether the solution will be transferred to the nodes of the extracted region or the cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvResampleAMR",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
